title: Logos 21 opening: Heb 3 — apostle and high priest; Son not made
english: Twenty-first discourse. On “consider the apostle and high priest of our confession,” gathering that the Son is neither made nor a creature.
If the Son were a product he would be numbered with all things; yet all things came to be through him, so he is not his own product.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
